description: Demonstrate basic understanding of startup concepts and entrepreneurial spirit.
Demonstrate the ability to build an appropriate team and express effective teamwork.
Conduct customer surveys and market research to understand customers, evaluate startup ideas, and find market fit.
Build the right product and a reasonable business model by developing and evaluating startup ideas, understanding customers and market fit, building products, and shaping business models.
Create and present a convincing preliminary pitch deck that introduces a startup, communicates fundraising and management considerations, and supports early-stage startup communication.
